label: Transaction-scoped Durability Level (Java SDK)
type: a single DurabilityLevel setting (Majority / MajorityAndPersistToActive / PersistToMajority / None) that applies to every key-value write inside one transaction attempt, configured once via TransactionsConfig/ClusterEnvironment (or per-call for a single query transaction) rather than per individual mutation call
note: Deliberately NOT the same concept as sdk:durability (kv-operations.md's per-operation durability option, promoted in round 30) - same underlying DurabilityLevel enum values, but the two are configured through entirely different, non-interchangeable API surfaces (TransactionsConfig.durabilityLevel(...) / singleQueryTransactionOptions().durabilityLevel(...) vs. InsertOptions.durability(...)). Related via relations/shares-option-set-with.json rather than treated as the same term. The same enum recurs at a THIRD scope again on the single-query-transaction page - see reconciliation.md round 4. UPDATE round 30: the single-query-transaction id this note refers to is now folded into concepts/n1ql/tximplicit.json as alias sdk:single-query-transaction - the Query-language mechanism, not an SDK-specific one - see that record's note.
